speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning, I see you're suffering from fatigue and severe itching alongside abnormal liver tests. To understand the cause, have you noticed any yellowing of your skin or eyes, or dark urine recently? REQUEST TEST: Liver Function Panel (with bilirubin fractionation, alkaline phosphatase, GGT, ALT, AST).

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Hemoglobin: 11.5 g/dL; Leukocyte_Count: 7500/mm3; Platelet_Count: 280,000/mm3; Na: 138 mEq/L; K: 4.7 mEq/L; Bilirubin_Total: 1.5 mg/dL; Bilirubin_Direct: 0.9 mg/dL; Alkaline_Phosphatase: 460 U/L; AST: 75 U/L; ALT: 78 U/L; Anti-Nuclear_Antibody: Negative; Antimitochondrial_Antibodies: Negative. Imaging Findings: Thickening of the bile ducts and focal bile duct dilatation.

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old male. The patient reports a 2-month history of increasing generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. He has known hypertension and was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis 5 years ago. He mentions being sexually active with 2 female partners and inconsistent condom use.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. I also have Scleral icterus, Multiple scratch marks on trunk and extremities. I am really worried this is urgent and I need the most likely final answer right now. Please do not delay by exploring too many alternative possibilities.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Biliary Cholangitis (PBC). The combination of severe pruritus, scleral icterus, and fatigue with abnormal liver function tests is highly suggestive of PBC; the elevated alkaline phosphatase from your requested panel would confirm cholestasis typical of this condition.
